snippet.title: SSB Alternate Universe - F3 Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
SSB Alternate Universe is an alternative take on the third installment of the Super Smash Bros. franchise that features redesigned fighter movesets, edited stage environments, revamped gameplay, new mechanics, improved single player modes, and online functionality (Now works with dolphin's intergrated netplay and theoreticalwith consoles as long at they are patched with wiimmfi `fan servers`). The mod can be run using Dolphin Emulator and it's also console compatible.

Updates on this project will be uploaded to this channel so stay tuned.
